content: I'll start by reading the test image to identify the disease symptoms.

The test image shows a tomato leaf with:
- Multiple dark/black irregular spots scattered across the entire leaf surface
- Spots ranging from small to medium, some coalescing
- Leaf shows distortion/curling
- No concentric rings (rules out Early Blight)
- No water-soaked gray lesions (rules out Late Blight)

The dark, scattered irregular spots most suggest **Bacterial Speck of Tomato** or **Septoria Leaf Blotch**. I'll use my one reference view on Bacterial Speck since the dark, numerous small spots with leaf distortion best match that profile.

The reference files are not accessible on this system. I'll make my classification based entirely on the visual analysis of the test image.

**Visual Analysis Summary:**
- **Plant part affected**: Tomato leaf (appears to show underside/surface view)
- **Lesion characteristics**: Numerous small to medium dark brown/black irregular spots scattered across the entire leaf
- **Pattern**: Non-concentric (rules out Early Blight), non-circular-with-gray-center (rules out Septoria), no water-soaked appearance (rules out Late Blight)
- **Leaf distortion**: Noticeable curling/rolling
- **Spot size**: Variable, some spots coalescing into larger dark patches
- **No visible**: concentric rings, white powdery coating, water-soaking, or fluffy sporulation

**Differential reasoning:**
- **Bacterial Speck**: Small (1-3mm) dark brown/black spots, irregular, scattered across leaf — strongly matches
- **Septoria Leaf Blotch**: Spots typically have lighter gray centers with dark borders — not clearly visible here
- **Early Blight**: Target/concentric ring pattern — not present
- **Tomato Spotted Wilt Virus**: Usually shows bronze ring patterns — not evident here
- **Late Blight**: Water-soaked lesions, white sporulation — not present

The numerous small-to-medium, dark/black, irregular spots scattered across the leaf without concentric rings or defined lighter centers, combined with leaf distortion, most closely fits **Bacterial Speck of Tomato**.
